title: Ice/Lightning Arch Mage — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API for jobs 1st–4th; WZ API for 5th/6th job skills and HEXA cores)

skills.name: Magic Guard
skills.description: A portion of the damage dealt to you affects your MP instead of your HP. Does not apply to attacks that inflict damage in proportion to your Max HP.\nActivates when you have 1 or more MP. Does not activate if you have 0 MP.

skills.name: MP Boost
skills.description: Increase Max MP and Attack Speed. Also increases MP proportional to your level.

skills.name: Elemental Weakness
skills.description: Your attacks make enemies vulnerable to Magic attacks, increasing all magical damage while they are debuffed.

skills.name: Magic Armor
skills.description: Uses magic to increase DEF.

skills.name: Energy Bolt
skills.description: Fire a condensed energy bolt that explodes on contact with an enemy.

skills.name: Teleport
skills.description: Allows you to teleport to other locations on the same map using the arrow keys. Permanently increases your Speed and Max Speed.

skills.name: Mana Wave
skills.description: Expel a blast of mana that propels you upwards. This skill is automatically triggered when you press the Jump key while holding the Up Arrow key. If you press the Jump key again and hold, you will slow your descent for a short period.

skills.name: Mana Wave
skills.description: Expel a blast of mana that propels you upwards. This skill is automatically triggered when you press the Jump key while holding the Up Arrow key. If you continue holding the Jump key, you will slow your descent for a short period.

skills.name: MP  Eater
skills.description: Absorb the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills. Absorption efficiency is reduced against bosses, resulting in less MP gained.

skills.name: Spell Mastery
skills.description: Increases Magic Mastery, Magic ATT, and Critical Rate.

skills.name: High Wisdom
skills.description: Permanently increase INT through mental discipline.

skills.name: Freezing Crush
skills.description: Grants bonus Critical Damage when attacking Frozen enemies. Bonus increases per stack of skill. Using lightning-based attacks against Frozen targets consumes stacks and increases Final Damage for each stack.

skills.name: Agile Magic
skills.description: Increases Attack Speed and Intelligence.

skills.name: Meditation
skills.description: Temporarily enhance the Magic ATT of all party members nearby through meditation.

skills.name: Thunder Bolt
skills.description: A lightning-attribute attack. Create a powerful magnetic field, which hurls down lightning bolts on up to 6 enemies.

skills.name: Cold Beam
skills.description: An ice-attribute attack. Grows sharp ice crystals in front. Any enemies who come in contact with the crystals will freeze and slow down. Deals great damage to fire-attribute enemies.

skills.name: Absolute Zero Aura
skills.description: Envelops party members in a shield of cold.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Storm Magic
skills.description: Increases final damage when you attack enemies under damage over time, stun, freeze, or darkness effects.

skills.name: Element Amplification
skills.description: Increases the MP cost and the Damage of your magic skills.

skills.name: Magic Critical
skills.description: Permanently increases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Shatter
skills.description: When attacking frozen enemies, you have a chance to ignore a portion of their defenses.

skills.name: Elemental Decrease
skills.description: Decreases the Elemental Resistance to all of your attacks. Also permanently increases final damage.

skills.name: Teleport Boost
skills.description: Enhances maneuverability by boosting the range of Teleport. Cannot be used in conjunction with Teleport Mastery - Range.

skills.name: Ice Strike
skills.description: Create an ice-attribute explosion near you that attacks nearby enemies.

skills.name: Teleport Mastery
skills.description: When activated, the skill consumes extra MP, and enemies at the teleport destination will take damage and become Stunned. Permanently increases Knockback Resistance.\nCan be toggled On/Off.#

skills.name: Thunder Sphere
skills.description:
Summon an orb of condensed lightning. The orb discharges a high-voltage current at nearby enemies to deal lightning-based damage. The orb can be fixed in place by pressing the skill key again with the down arrow key. The orb will then be periodically summoned to attack enemies in a wider range. The orb's attack does not consume freezing stacks.
With Action Customization enabled, you can fix the orb by pressing its skill key again, without use of the arrow keys.
Cannot be registered to a skill sequence while fixing the orb.
Right-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF

skills.name: Elemental Adaptation (Ice, Lightning)
skills.description: Form a barrier of ice and lightning. Regenerates after blocking a debilitating status condition, and goes on cooldown after successfully blocking status conditions a certain number of times.\nAlso permanently increases Status Resistance and Elemental Resistance.

skills.name: Frost Ward
skills.description: Creates a bulwark of jagged ice that pushes enemies backwards, damaging them. Freezes and slows enemies on hit. Deals extra damage to fire-attribute enemies.

skills.name: Thunder Sphere
skills.description: Summon a sphere of lightning.

skills.name: Infinity
skills.description: Bolsters the spirit to enhance your magic and recover HP and MP.

skills.name: Arcane Aim
skills.description: Ignores a portion of enemy Defense when attacking. Damage dealt increases with consecutive attacks. Stacks up to 5 times.

skills.name: Buff Mastery
skills.description: Permanently increases Magic Attack and increases the duration of all buffs on you. Also permanently increases Knockback Resistance.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.description: Summon spears of ice from the sky to attack a single enemy.

skills.name: Frost Clutch
skills.description: Increases the effect of Freezing Crush.

skills.name: Teleport Mastery - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Teleport Mastery damage.

skills.name: Teleport Mastery - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Teleport Mastery.

skills.name: Chain Lightning - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Chain Lightning damage.

skills.name: Chain Lightning - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Chain Lightning.

skills.name: Chain Lightning - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Chain Lightning's number of attacks.

skills.name: Frozen Orb - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Frozen Orb.

skills.name: Frozen Orb - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Frozen Orb.

skills.name: Frozen Orb - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases Frozen Orb critical chance bonus.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Freezing Breath
skills.description: An ice-attribute attack. Freeze yourself and your enemies with cold, powerful air to stun them and continually reduce their Defense.\nEnemies hit by this skill will resist any further stuns for 90 seconds.

skills.name: Elquines
skills.description: Summons Elquines for a short time. Elquines can attack multiple enemies at once. Attacks from Elquines freeze enemies and do not trigger attack reflection. Permanently increases Spell Mastery.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.description: Attack the target with a high-voltage lightning-attribute attack, stunning the enemy with a high critical rate. Chain Lightning can chain attack targets near the target.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.description: Summons spears of ice from the sky, showering multiple enemies with a nasty blizzard to freeze them. Upon attacking, permanently grants a chance to damage single a enemy with a Blizzard.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Freezing Breath
skills.description: An ice-attribute attack. Freeze yourself and your enemies with cold, powerful air to stun them and continually reduce their Defense.\nEnemies hit by this skill will resist any further stuns for 90 seconds.

skills.name: Frozen Orb
skills.description: Create and throw a Frozen Orb that fires ice shards everywhere to deal ice damage. The orb slows significantly when it encounters an enemy. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Teleport Mastery - Range
skills.description: Significantly increases the movement range of Teleport. Does not stack with Teleport Boost.\nCan be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Lightning Orb
skills.description: Creates a large, unstable sphere of electricity to continuously zap enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.

skills.name: Epic Adventure
skills.description: Call upon the bravery deep within to increase damage output.

skills.name: Glacial Fury
skills.description: Harnesses the extreme cold to greatly enhance your ice's Magic ATT.

skills.name: Mana Overload
skills.description: Increases your attack skills by overloading the mana flowing through you.\nRight-click to lock activation effect.#

Current zones prioritize appearing at the location of the boss with the highest Max HP first. Current zones do not consume freeze stacks.

notes: Frames listed with placeholder=true are 1x1 timing placeholders in the source WZ data; the player skips them.

Skill/214.img and Skill/224.img are the 6th-job (HEXA) skill files for F/P and I/L respectively — not Hyper files. Their skillbook endpoints failed (214: hangs / 16-byte error responses after 4 attempts; 224: HTTP 400 "Unknown ExtendedProperty type Canvas#Video"), so those skills were pulled frame-by-frame from the raw WZ API. Skill/234.img (Bishop HEXA) came from its skillbook, which succeeded after retries; the WZ pull for 234 is kept only as a supplement for the effect0 layers the skillbook JSON drops, and is deduplicated by skill ID.

5th-job (Skill/40002.img) effect/hit frames are largely not retrievable from maplestory.io in GMS 270: the effect/hit nodes list frames, but GETs for frames past index 0 hang (>55 s, no response) or return "Nothing was found", and the job 40002 skillbook endpoint returns HTTP 502/524. V skills are included with icons, descriptions and whatever placeholder frame(s) resolved; the unretrievable frames are recorded per skill (status PARTIAL) and in the manifest missing list.
Job 200 (Intro to Magic) skills are shared by all three Magician classes and are included in each class folder.

Mind Delve / Unreliable Memory (shared Magician 5th-job skills) have no entries in Skill/40002.img in GMS 270 and are not included; Maple World Goddess's Blessing (400001042, Skill/40000.img) is a shared skill and is not included, matching the Hero scope.
Ice Age was removed from the game (per maplestorywiki) and has no entry in Skill/40002.img; the current I/L 5th-job set is Frost Ark, Bolt Barrage, Spirit of Snow, Jupiter Thunder.
I/L HEXA origin skills pulled from Skill/224.img: Frozen Lightning (2241500-2241504) and Parabolic Bolt (2241505-2241506).
